satellites.split_rationale: Negotiated terms that change rarely, kept apart from the running receipt and on-order figures.

satellites.name: sat_product_vendor_receipt
satellites.description: Running operational figures: last receipt cost, last receipt date and quantity currently on order.
satellites.split_rationale: Fast-changing running values, separated from the agreed terms by rate of change.

satellites.name: sat_purchase_order_details
satellites.description: Order status, revision number, order date and estimated ship date, with history of status changes and revisions.
satellites.split_rationale: Lifecycle and status attributes, kept apart from the financial totals.

satellites.name: sat_purchase_order_totals
satellites.description: Order-level financial totals: subtotal, tax, freight and total due.
satellites.split_rationale: Monetary amounts, split from the status attributes by data type.

satellites.name: sat_purchase_order_detail_order
satellites.description: Ordered terms on each line: quantity ordered, unit price, line total and due date.
satellites.split_rationale: Values set when the order is placed, which rarely change afterwards.

satellites.name: sat_purchase_order_detail_receipt
satellites.description: Cumulative received, rejected and accepted quantities on each line. History shows how they progress, including partial deliveries.
satellites.split_rationale: Receipt and inspection progress changes over the life of the order, separately from the ordered terms.

satellites.name: sat_ship_method_details
satellites.description: Shipping company name (the business identifier). The rowguid replication column is left out because it has no business meaning.
satellites.split_rationale: Stable descriptive name, kept apart from the rates.

satellites.name: sat_ship_method_rates
satellites.description: Ship base (minimum charge) and ship rate (charge per pound), with history so historical freight can be checked against the rates in force at the time.
satellites.split_rationale: Commercial rates with required history, which change at a different rate from the name.

satellites.name: sat_customer_details
satellites.description: Customer record technical trace and last-modified date for reconciliation.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_store_details
satellites.description: Store name and change tracking.
satellites.split_rationale: Non-confidential store descriptors separated from confidential demographics.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_store_demographics
satellites.description: Confidential store demographics (employees, annual sales, store type).
satellites.split_rationale: Commercially sensitive classification.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_sales_person_compensation
satellites.description: Current quota, bonus and commission of a sales representative (remuneration data, restricted).
satellites.split_rationale: Remuneration data, restricted access, changes rarely.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_sales_person_performance
satellites.description: Operational running sales totals of a representative.
satellites.split_rationale: Running totals change frequently.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_sales_quota_history
satellites.description: Dated sales quota history per representative.

satellites.name: sat_sales_person_territory_history_effectivity
satellites.description: Active period of each representative territory assignment; open-ended while active.

satellites.name: sat_sales_territory_details
satellites.description: Territory name and geographic group.
satellites.split_rationale: Slow-changing descriptors separated from running financials.

satellites.name: sat_sales_territory_financials
satellites.description: Territory year-to-date and previous-year sales and costs.
satellites.split_rationale: Running totals change frequently.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_details
satellites.description: Order dates, status, channel, references, comments and revision.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_totals
satellites.description: Order financial amounts as computed by the source.
satellites.split_rationale: Financial measures grouped separately from descriptive order data.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_payment
satellites.description: Payment approval code for reconciliation and disputes.
satellites.split_rationale: Payment-sensitive classification.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_line_details
satellites.description: Order line quantity, pricing, discount, line total and tracking number.

satellites.name: sat_credit_card_details
satellites.description: Card type of a credit card.
satellites.split_rationale: Non-restricted card attributes.

satellites.name: sat_credit_card_sensitive
satellites.description: Restricted card number and expiry data.
satellites.split_rationale: Sensitive payment data, restricted access.

satellites.name: sat_currency_details
satellites.description: Currency name.

satellites.name: sat_currency_rate_details
satellites.description: Average and end-of-day exchange rates.

satellites.name: sat_special_offer_details
satellites.description: Special offer description, type, category and quantity thresholds.

satellites.name: sat_special_offer_discount
satellites.description: Discount percentage of a special offer, tracked over time.
satellites.split_rationale: Commercially significant attribute whose change history is required.

satellites.name: sat_special_offer_validity
satellites.description: Validity period of a special offer.

satellites.name: sat_sales_reason_details
satellites.description: Sales reason description and reason category.

satellites.name: sat_sales_tax_rate_details
satellites.description: Tax rate description and amount.

satellites.name: sat_shopping_cart_item_details
satellites.description: Cart item quantity and creation timestamp.

contracts.name: CountryRegionCurrency
contracts.doc: Mapping of country/region codes to the currency codes used in each, staged from the Sales.CountryRegionCurrency source table. The contract enforces the declared schema and business-key uniqueness/not-null; ownership and agreement are to be confirmed at the human review checkpoint.

schema.name: CountryRegionCode
schema.description: Code identifying the country or region. Part of the business key; relates to the country/region reference data.

schema.name: CurrencyCode
schema.description: Code identifying the currency used in the country or region. Part of the business key; relates to the Currency asset's CurrencyCode.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: CreditCard
contracts.doc: Source-to-staging asset for credit card records from the Sales schema. Each record describes a payment card (type, number, expiration month and year) and when it was last modified. The contract enforces the declared schema, primary key and not-null constraints; value-level semantics are alerting only because no requirements mandate blocking checks. Ownership and agreement status are to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: CreditCardID
schema.description: Unique identifier of the credit card record in the source system.

schema.name: CardType
schema.description: Type or brand of the credit card. The allowed value set is not stated in the requirements.

schema.name: CardNumber
schema.description: Credit card number as held in the source. This is sensitive payment data, so consumers should review its handling and masking.

schema.name: ExpMonth
schema.description: Expiration month of the credit card.

schema.name: ExpYear
schema.description: Expiration year of the credit card.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified in the source system.

contracts.name: Currency
contracts.doc: Reference list of currencies from the Sales source schema, identified by CurrencyCode. The contract enforces the declared schema and business key; value-level semantics are limited to what the requirements support. Ownership and agreement status are to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: CurrencyCode
schema.description: Code that identifies the currency. This is the business key of the Currency asset.

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name of the currency.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified in the source system.

contracts.name: CurrencyRate
contracts.doc: Currency exchange rates between a source and target currency for a given date, sourced from the Sales.CurrencyRate table. The contract enforces the declared schema, business-key uniqueness, and not-null on keys; value-level semantics are advisory pending producer/consumer review.

schema.name: CurrencyRateID
schema.description: Unique identifier for the currency rate record (source surrogate key).

schema.name: CurrencyRateDate
schema.description: Date and time the exchange rate was obtained.

schema.name: FromCurrencyCode
schema.description: Source (from) currency code for the exchange rate; refers to Currency.CurrencyCode.

schema.name: ToCurrencyCode
schema.description: Target (to) currency code for the exchange rate; refers to Currency.CurrencyCode.

schema.name: AverageRate
schema.description: Average exchange rate for the day.

schema.name: EndOfDayRate
schema.description: Final exchange rate for the day.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last updated in the source.

contracts.name: Customer
contracts.doc: Customer records from the Sales source, staged for the data vault. Each row represents a customer, who may be an individual (PersonID) or a store (StoreID), optionally assigned to a sales territory. The contract enforces the declared schema, business key and not-null rules. Ownership and agreement are to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: CustomerID
schema.description: Unique identifier of the customer.

schema.name: PersonID
schema.description: Identifier of the individual person associated with the customer. It references a person record. It may be absent for store customers.

schema.name: StoreID
schema.description: Identifier of the store associated with the customer. It references a store record. It may be absent for individual customers.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales territory the customer belongs to.

schema.name: AccountNumber
schema.description: Customer account number used as a business-facing reference.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique row identifier (GUID) assigned in the source system.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: PersonCreditCard
contracts.doc: Association between a person (business entity) and a credit card they hold, sourced from the Sales PersonCreditCard table. The contract enforces the declared schema and business-key integrity; ownership and agreement are to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the business entity (person) that holds the credit card. Refers to a person record in the source system.

schema.name: CreditCardID
schema.description: Identifier of the credit card associated with the business entity. Refers to the CreditCard record in the source system.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesOrderDetail
contracts.doc: Line-item level detail of a sales order, one row per product line within a sales order (source: SalesOrderDetail). The contract enforces the declared schema, business-key uniqueness and not-null on keys; value-level semantics are soft (alerting) pending producer/consumer review.

schema.name: SalesOrderID
schema.description: Identifier of the parent sales order (references SalesOrderHeader).

schema.name: SalesOrderDetailID
schema.description: Identifier of the line item within the sales order detail table.

schema.name: CarrierTrackingNumber
schema.description: Shipment tracking number assigned by the carrier for this line item. May be absent if not shipped.

schema.name: OrderQty
schema.description: Quantity of the product ordered on this line.

schema.name: ProductID
schema.description: Identifier of the product ordered (references Product).

schema.name: SpecialOfferID
schema.description: Identifier of the special offer applied to this line (references SpecialOffer).

schema.name: UnitPrice
schema.description: Selling price of a single unit of the product on this line.

schema.name: UnitPriceDiscount
schema.description: Discount applied to the unit price for this line.

schema.name: LineTotal
schema.description: Total value of the line (per-unit price after discount multiplied by quantity); typically derived in the source.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique identifier (GUID) for the row.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the row was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: SalesOrderHeader
contracts.doc: Sales order header records: one row per customer sales order, with order dates, status, customer/sales person/territory references, billing and shipping references, payment references, and monetary totals. Staged from the source SalesOrderHeader table. The contract enforces the declared schema, business key and not-null rules. Value-level semantics are not yet specified and need producer/consumer review.

schema.name: SalesOrderID
schema.description: Unique identifier of the sales order (header). Business key of the asset.

schema.name: RevisionNumber
schema.description: Revision number of the sales order, tracking changes to the order over time.

schema.name: OrderDate
schema.description: Date the sales order was placed.

schema.name: DueDate
schema.description: Date the order is due to the customer.

schema.name: ShipDate
schema.description: Date the order was shipped to the customer.

schema.name: Status
schema.description: Current status code of the order. Allowed values are not defined in the requirements; needs review.

schema.name: OnlineOrderFlag
schema.description: Indicates whether the order was placed online (as opposed to through a sales person). Representation (boolean vs coded) needs review.

schema.name: SalesOrderNumber
schema.description: Human-readable sales order number.

schema.name: PurchaseOrderNumber
schema.description: Customer's purchase order reference for the order.

schema.name: AccountNumber
schema.description: Customer account number associated with the order.

schema.name: CustomerID
schema.description: Identifier of the customer who placed the order; references Customer.

schema.name: SalesPersonID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales person who handled the order; references SalesPerson.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales territory the order belongs to; references SalesTerritory.

schema.name: BillToAddressID
schema.description: Identifier of the billing address for the order.

schema.name: ShipToAddressID
schema.description: Identifier of the shipping address for the order.

schema.name: ShipMethodID
schema.description: Identifier of the shipping method used for the order.

schema.name: CreditCardID
schema.description: Identifier of the credit card used to pay for the order; references CreditCard.

schema.name: CreditCardApprovalCode
schema.description: Approval code provided by the credit card company for the payment.

schema.name: CurrencyRateID
schema.description: Identifier of the currency rate applied to the order; references CurrencyRate.

schema.name: SubTotal
schema.description: Order subtotal (sum of line totals) before tax and freight.

schema.name: TaxAmt
schema.description: Tax amount charged on the order.

schema.name: Freight
schema.description: Shipping (freight) charge for the order.

schema.name: TotalDue
schema.description: Total amount due from the customer for the order.

schema.name: Comment
schema.description: Free-text sales representative comments on the order.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique row identifier (GUID) used by the source system.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesOrderHeaderSalesReason
contracts.doc: Association between sales orders and the sales reasons recorded for them (many-to-many link between SalesOrderHeader and SalesReason). Draft contract: enforces the declared schema and key columns; ownership and agreement are to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: SalesOrderID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales order (header) this reason is associated with; references SalesOrderHeader.

schema.name: SalesReasonID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales reason associated with the order; references SalesReason.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesPerson
contracts.doc: Sales representatives (salespeople) staged from the source SalesPerson table, with their sales territory assignment, quota, bonus, commission percentage and year-to-date / prior-year sales figures. The contract enforces the declared schema, business key and not-null rules; no value-level thresholds are mandated by the requirements. Ownership and agreement are to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the salesperson's business entity; business key for the salesperson record.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales territory the salesperson is currently assigned to; may be absent if unassigned.

schema.name: SalesQuota
schema.description: Projected yearly sales quota for the salesperson; may be absent if no quota is set.

schema.name: Bonus
schema.description: Bonus amount due to the salesperson.

schema.name: CommissionPct
schema.description: Commission percentage received per sale.

schema.name: SalesYTD
schema.description: Sales total for the salesperson year to date.

schema.name: SalesLastYear
schema.description: Sales total for the salesperson in the previous year.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique identifier (GUID) for the source row.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source row was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesPersonQuotaHistory
contracts.doc: Historical record of sales quotas assigned to sales people, one row per sales person (BusinessEntityID) and quota date. The contract enforces the declared schema and the business key columns; no value-level thresholds are mandated by the requirements.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales person (business entity) to whom the quota applies.

schema.name: QuotaDate
schema.description: Date on which the sales quota became effective for the sales person.

schema.name: SalesQuota
schema.description: Sales quota amount assigned to the sales person as of the quota date.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique identifier (GUID) for the row, used as a row-level identifier by the source system.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source row was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesReason
contracts.doc: Lookup of reasons a customer gave for purchasing a product, sourced from the SalesReason source table and staged as-is. The contract enforces the declared schema and business key (SalesReasonID); no value-level thresholds are mandated by the requirements.

schema.name: SalesReasonID
schema.description: Unique identifier of the sales reason; business key of the asset.

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name or description of the sales reason.

schema.name: ReasonType
schema.description: Category of the sales reason.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesTaxRate
contracts.doc: Sales tax rates by state/province, staged from the source SalesTaxRate table. The contract enforces the declared schema and business key; value-level semantics are minimal pending producer/consumer review.

schema.name: SalesTaxRateID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales tax rate record.

schema.name: StateProvinceID
schema.description: Identifier of the state or province to which the tax rate applies.

schema.name: TaxType
schema.description: Code indicating the type of tax the rate represents. The allowed values are not specified in the requirements.

schema.name: TaxRate
schema.description: Tax rate amount. The unit (percentage or fraction) is not specified in the requirements.

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name of the tax rate.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique identifier (GUID) for the row.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesTerritory
contracts.doc: Sales territory reference data: one record per sales territory, with its name, country/region, sales group, and year-to-date and prior-year sales and cost figures. Source-to-staging contract; schema, primary-key and not-null breaches are enforced as hard failures by the core. Ownership and agreement are pending human review.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales territory (business key).

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name of the sales territory.

schema.name: CountryRegionCode
schema.description: Code identifying the country or region the territory belongs to.

schema.name: Group
schema.description: Geographic sales group the territory belongs to.

schema.name: SalesYTD
schema.description: Sales in the territory year to date.

schema.name: SalesLastYear
schema.description: Sales in the territory in the previous year.

schema.name: CostYTD
schema.description: Business costs in the territory year to date.

schema.name: CostLastYear
schema.description: Business costs in the territory in the previous year.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique identifier (GUID) for the row, used by the source for replication.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesTerritoryHistory
contracts.doc: Historical record of the sales territories to which each salesperson has been assigned over time, with start and end dates of each assignment. Staged from the source SalesTerritoryHistory table. The contract enforces the declared schema and business-key constraints; value-level semantics are pending producer/consumer review.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the salesperson (business entity) assigned to the territory.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales territory the salesperson was assigned to.

schema.name: StartDate
schema.description: Date and time the salesperson's assignment to the territory began.

schema.name: EndDate
schema.description: Date and time the assignment to the territory ended; absent when the assignment is current.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique row identifier (GUID) assigned by the source system.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source row was last modified.

contracts.name: ShoppingCartItem
contracts.doc: Items a customer has added to an online shopping cart, as staged from the Sales.ShoppingCartItem source table. The contract enforces the declared schema, primary key and not-null rules. No value-level thresholds are stated in the requirements.

schema.name: ShoppingCartItemID
schema.description: Unique identifier for a shopping cart item row.

schema.name: ShoppingCartID
schema.description: Identifier of the shopping cart the item belongs to.

schema.name: Quantity
schema.description: Number of units of the product in the shopping cart.

schema.name: ProductID
schema.description: Identifier of the product added to the shopping cart.

schema.name: DateCreated
schema.description: Date and time the item was added to the shopping cart.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source row was last modified.

contracts.name: SpecialOffer
contracts.doc: Sales promotion (special offer) definitions from the source system, including discount percentage, offer type and category, validity period, and quantity thresholds. The contract enforces the declared schema and business key; value-level semantics are advisory pending producer/consumer review.

schema.name: SpecialOfferID
schema.description: Unique identifier of the special offer.

schema.name: Description
schema.description: Description of the special offer.

schema.name: DiscountPct
schema.description: Discount percentage applied by the special offer.

schema.name: Type
schema.description: Type of discount offered by the special offer.

schema.name: Category
schema.description: Group or category the special offer belongs to.

schema.name: StartDate
schema.description: Date and time the special offer becomes valid.

schema.name: EndDate
schema.description: Date and time the special offer stops being valid.

schema.name: MinQty
schema.description: Minimum order quantity required to qualify for the special offer.

schema.name: MaxQty
schema.description: Maximum order quantity eligible for the special offer; may be absent when no upper limit applies.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Row-level globally unique identifier (GUID) assigned in the source system.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: SpecialOfferProduct
contracts.doc: Association between special offers and the products they apply to (many-to-many link). The contract enforces the declared schema and key/not-null constraints; no value-level thresholds are mandated by the requirements.

schema.name: SpecialOfferID
schema.description: Identifier of the special offer; references the SpecialOffer asset.

schema.name: ProductID
schema.description: Identifier of the product covered by the special offer.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique row identifier (GUID) for the record.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified.

contracts.name: Store
contracts.doc: Source-to-staging asset for Store: customer stores (resellers) tracked in the sales domain, each identified by a business entity and optionally assigned to a salesperson. The contract enforces the declared schema, business-key uniqueness and not-null rules; value-level semantics are minimal pending producer/consumer review.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the business entity that represents the store; business key for the Store asset.

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name of the store.

schema.name: SalesPersonID
schema.description: Identifier of the salesperson assigned to the store; references a salesperson business entity.

schema.name: Demographics
schema.description: Demographic/survey information about the store. Format not specified in the requirements; flagged for human review.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Row-level globally unique identifier for the source record.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

satellites. Review `review-queue.md` and `contracts/` before agreeing the model.

# ADR-0001: Data Vault model derived from requirements

**Status:** Proposed
**Date:** 2026-10-23
**Decision makers:** Vault-Agent (generated) — pending human review

## Context

This model was derived automatically by the Vault-Agent pipeline from 197 requirement(s) and 20 business key candidate(s). It records the Data Vault 2.0 structures the modeler chose and traces each back to the requirements that justify it.

## Decision

Model the following Data Vault 2.0 structures.

### Hubs (11)

- **hub_customer** — business key `AccountNumber`. A customer (individual person or store), identified by the customer account number assigned by the accounting system. _(requirements: REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-050-2, REQ-054-3)_
- **hub_sales_order** — business key `SalesOrderNumber`. A sales order, identified by its unique sales order number. _(requirements: REQ-016, REQ-001, REQ-054-3)_
- **hub_sales_order_line** — business key `sales_order_line`. A sales order line, identified within its order by an incremental line number. _(requirements: REQ-044, REQ-042-2)_
- **hub_sales_territory** — business key `TerritoryID`. A sales territory in the territory catalogue. _(requirements: REQ-067, REQ-054-2)_
- **hub_credit_card** — business key `CreditCardID`. A credit card in the payment card register, identified by its operational card record. _(requirements: REQ-074)_
- **hub_currency** — business key `CurrencyCode`. A currency identified by its ISO currency code. _(requirements: REQ-021-2)_
- **hub_currency_rate** — business key `currency_rate`. A daily currency exchange rate, identified by rate date, from-currency and to-currency. _(requirements: REQ-023-2, REQ-057-2, REQ-019-3, REQ-020-3)_
- **hub_special_offer** — business key `SpecialOfferID`. A special offer (promotion) in the offer catalogue. _(requirements: REQ-008-2, REQ-050)_
- **hub_sales_reason** — business key `SalesReasonID`. A sales reason in the sales reason catalogue. _(requirements: REQ-054)_
- **hub_shopping_cart_item** — business key `shopping_cart_item`. A shopping cart item, identified within its shopping cart. _(requirements: REQ-001-2, REQ-002-2, REQ-059-2)_
- **hub_sales_tax_rate** — business key `sales_tax_rate`. A sales tax rate for a jurisdiction and tax type. _(requirements: REQ-033-2, REQ-058-2)_

### Links (20)

- **link_customer_person** — connects hub_customer, hub_business_entity (person). An individual customer and the person who is the customer. _(requirements: REQ-005, REQ-004, REQ-050-2, REQ-002)_
- **link_customer_store** — connects hub_customer, hub_business_entity (store). A store customer and the store it represents. _(requirements: REQ-006, REQ-004, REQ-050-2)_
- **link_customer_sales_territory** — connects hub_customer, hub_sales_territory. The sales territory in which a customer is located. _(requirements: REQ-007, REQ-009, REQ-049-2, REQ-023-3)_
- **link_store_sales_person** — connects hub_business_entity (store), hub_business_entity (sales_person). The sales representative assigned to a reseller store. _(requirements: REQ-013, REQ-051-2, REQ-023-3, REQ-037-3)_
- **link_sales_person_sales_territory** — connects hub_business_entity (sales_person), hub_sales_territory. The territory a sales representative is currently assigned to (from the representative record). _(requirements: REQ-060, REQ-052-2, REQ-016-3)_
- **link_sales_person_territory_history** — connects hub_business_entity (sales_person), hub_sales_territory. Dated history of territory assignments per sales representative. Driving key: hub_business_entity (sales_person). _(requirements: REQ-053-2, REQ-009-3, REQ-010-3, REQ-011-3, REQ-012-3, REQ-014-3, REQ-015-3)_
- **link_sales_territory_country_region** — connects hub_sales_territory, hub_country_region. The country/region a sales territory belongs to. _(requirements: REQ-068, REQ-054-2, REQ-073)_
- **link_sales_order** — connects hub_sales_order, hub_customer, hub_business_entity (sales_person), hub_sales_territory, hub_address (bill_to), hub_address (ship_to), hub_ship_method, hub_credit_card, hub_currency_rate. The sales order header event: the order with its customer, representative, territory, billing and shipping addresses, ship method, credit card and currency rate. Unit of work: SalesOrderNumber with CustomerID, SalesPersonID, TerritoryID, BillToAddressID, ShipToAddressID, ShipMethodID, CreditCardID, CurrencyRateID. _(requirements: REQ-017, REQ-019, REQ-020, REQ-028, REQ-029, REQ-030, REQ-039, REQ-042, REQ-039-2, REQ-040-2, REQ-041-2, REQ-046-2, REQ-048-2, REQ-061-2, REQ-062-2, REQ-002)_
- **link_sales_order_line** — connects hub_sales_order_line, hub_sales_order, hub_product, hub_special_offer. An order line within its order, selling one product under a special offer. Unit of work: SalesOrderID, SalesOrderDetailID, ProductID, SpecialOfferID. _(requirements: REQ-045, REQ-050, REQ-042-2, REQ-043-2, REQ-044-2, REQ-020-2)_
- **link_sales_order_sales_reason** — connects hub_sales_order, hub_sales_reason. Sales reasons cited on an order (many-to-many). _(requirements: REQ-056, REQ-045-2, REQ-057, REQ-058)_
- **link_business_entity_credit_card** — connects hub_business_entity, hub_credit_card. Credit cards registered to persons (many-to-many). _(requirements: REQ-079, REQ-047-2, REQ-080)_
- **link_currency_rate_currency** — connects hub_currency_rate, hub_currency (from), hub_currency (to). The from- and to-currency of an exchange rate. _(requirements: REQ-023-2, REQ-057-2)_
- **link_country_region_currency** — connects hub_country_region, hub_currency. Currencies used in countries/regions (many-to-many). _(requirements: REQ-030-2, REQ-031-2, REQ-056-2, REQ-032-2)_
- **link_sales_tax_rate_state_province** — connects hub_sales_tax_rate, hub_state_province. The state/province jurisdiction a tax rate applies to. _(requirements: REQ-034-2, REQ-058-2, REQ-037-2)_
- **link_special_offer_product** — connects hub_special_offer, hub_product. Products covered by a special offer (many-to-many). _(requirements: REQ-018-2, REQ-019-2, REQ-055-2, REQ-020-2)_
- **link_shopping_cart_item_product** — connects hub_shopping_cart_item, hub_product. The product in a shopping cart item. _(requirements: REQ-003-2, REQ-059-2, REQ-006-2)_
- **link_sales_order_line_product** — connects hub_sales_order_line, hub_product. Declared foreign key SalesOrderDetail.ProductID references PRODUCTID; ratified from the source catalogue (WP34). _(requirements: —)_
- **link_sales_order_address** — connects hub_sales_order, hub_address. Declared foreign key SalesOrderHeader.BillToAddressID references ADDRESSID; ratified from the source catalogue (WP34). _(requirements: —)_
- **link_sales_order_business_entity** — connects hub_sales_order, hub_business_entity. Declared foreign key SalesOrderHeader.SalesPersonID references BUSINESSENTITYID; ratified from the source catalogue (WP34). _(requirements: —)_
- **link_sales_order_ship_method** — connects hub_sales_order, hub_ship_method. Declared foreign key SalesOrderHeader.ShipMethodID references SHIPMETHODID; ratified from the source catalogue (WP34). _(requirements: —)_

### Satellites (23)

- **sat_customer_details** — on hub_customer; payload: ModifiedDate, rowguid. Customer record technical trace and last-modified date for reconciliation. Source table: Customer. _(requirements: REQ-008, REQ-024-3, REQ-053-3)_
- **sat_business_entity_store_details** — on hub_business_entity; payload: Name, ModifiedDate, rowguid. Store name and change tracking. Source table: Store. Split rationale: Non-confidential store descriptors separated from confidential demographics.. _(requirements: REQ-012, REQ-024-3)_
- **sat_business_entity_store_demographics** — on hub_business_entity; payload: Demographics. Confidential store demographics (employees, annual sales, store type). Source table: Store. Split rationale: Commercially sensitive classification.. _(requirements: REQ-014, REQ-015, REQ-052-3, REQ-023-3)_
- **sat_business_entity_sales_person_compensation** — on hub_business_entity; payload: SalesQuota, Bonus, CommissionPct. Current quota, bonus and commission of a sales representative (remuneration data, restricted). Source table: SalesPerson. Split rationale: Remuneration data, restricted access, changes rarely.. _(requirements: REQ-061, REQ-062, REQ-063, REQ-006-3, REQ-051-3)_
- **sat_business_entity_sales_person_performance** — on hub_business_entity; payload: SalesYTD, SalesLastYear, ModifiedDate, rowguid. Operational running sales totals of a representative. Source table: SalesPerson. Split rationale: Running totals change frequently.. _(requirements: REQ-064, REQ-065, REQ-046-3, REQ-051-3)_
- **sat_business_entity_sales_quota_history** — on hub_business_entity; payload: SalesQuota, ModifiedDate, rowguid. Dated sales quota history per representative. Multi-active satellite, child dependent key: QuotaDate. Source table: SalesPersonQuotaHistory. _(requirements: REQ-001-3, REQ-002-3, REQ-003-3, REQ-004-3, REQ-005-3, REQ-008-3, REQ-051-3)_
- **sat_sales_person_territory_history_effectivity** — on link_sales_person_territory_history; payload: StartDate, EndDate. Active period of each representative territory assignment; open-ended while active. Effectivity satellite. Source table: SalesTerritoryHistory. _(requirements: REQ-009-3, REQ-010-3, REQ-011-3, REQ-012-3, REQ-013-3, REQ-015-3, REQ-044-3, REQ-045-3)_
- **sat_sales_territory_details** — on hub_sales_territory; payload: Name, Group, ModifiedDate, rowguid. Territory name and geographic group. Source table: SalesTerritory. Split rationale: Slow-changing descriptors separated from running financials.. _(requirements: REQ-067, REQ-069, REQ-073, REQ-023-3)_
- **sat_sales_territory_financials** — on hub_sales_territory; payload: SalesYTD, SalesLastYear, CostYTD, CostLastYear. Territory year-to-date and previous-year sales and costs. Source table: SalesTerritory. Split rationale: Running totals change frequently.. _(requirements: REQ-070, REQ-071, REQ-072, REQ-031-3, REQ-046-3)_
- **sat_sales_order_details** — on hub_sales_order; payload: RevisionNumber, OrderDate, DueDate, ShipDate, Status, OnlineOrderFlag, PurchaseOrderNumber, AccountNumber, Comment, ModifiedDate, rowguid. Order dates, status, channel, references, comments and revision. Source table: SalesOrderHeader. _(requirements: REQ-018, REQ-021, REQ-022, REQ-023, REQ-024, REQ-025, REQ-026, REQ-027, REQ-031, REQ-033, REQ-033-3, REQ-034-3)_
- **sat_sales_order_totals** — on hub_sales_order; payload: SubTotal, TaxAmt, Freight, TotalDue. Order financial amounts as computed by the source. Source table: SalesOrderHeader. Split rationale: Financial measures grouped separately from descriptive order data.. _(requirements: REQ-034, REQ-035, REQ-036, REQ-037, REQ-038, REQ-040-3, REQ-054-3)_
- **sat_sales_order_payment** — on hub_sales_order; payload: CreditCardApprovalCode. Payment approval code for reconciliation and disputes. Source table: SalesOrderHeader. Split rationale: Payment-sensitive classification.. _(requirements: REQ-040, REQ-049-3)_
- **sat_sales_order_line_details** — on hub_sales_order_line; payload: CarrierTrackingNumber, OrderQty, UnitPrice, UnitPriceDiscount, LineTotal, ModifiedDate, rowguid. Order line quantity, pricing, discount, line total and tracking number. Source table: SalesOrderDetail. _(requirements: REQ-046, REQ-047, REQ-048, REQ-049, REQ-051, REQ-052, REQ-053, REQ-041-3)_
- **sat_credit_card_details** — on hub_credit_card; payload: CardType, ModifiedDate. Card type of a credit card. Source table: CreditCard. Split rationale: Non-restricted card attributes.. _(requirements: REQ-075, REQ-076)_
- **sat_credit_card_sensitive** — on hub_credit_card; payload: CardNumber, ExpMonth, ExpYear. Restricted card number and expiry data. Source table: CreditCard. Split rationale: Sensitive payment data, restricted access.. _(requirements: REQ-075, REQ-077, REQ-078, REQ-049-3)_
- **sat_currency_details** — on hub_currency; payload: Name, ModifiedDate. Currency name. Source table: Currency. _(requirements: REQ-021-2, REQ-022-2)_
- **sat_currency_rate_details** — on hub_currency_rate; payload: AverageRate, EndOfDayRate, ModifiedDate. Average and end-of-day exchange rates. Source table: CurrencyRate. _(requirements: REQ-024-2, REQ-025-2, REQ-026-2, REQ-028-2)_
- **sat_special_offer_details** — on hub_special_offer; payload: Description, Type, Category, MinQty, MaxQty, ModifiedDate, rowguid. Special offer description, type, category and quantity thresholds. Source table: SpecialOffer. _(requirements: REQ-008-2, REQ-010-2, REQ-011-2, REQ-012-2, REQ-013-2, REQ-017-2)_
- **sat_special_offer_discount** — on hub_special_offer; payload: DiscountPct. Discount percentage of a special offer, tracked over time. Source table: SpecialOffer. Split rationale: Commercially significant attribute whose change history is required.. _(requirements: REQ-009-2, REQ-023-3)_
- **sat_special_offer_validity** — on hub_special_offer; payload: StartDate, EndDate. Validity period of a special offer. Source table: SpecialOffer. _(requirements: REQ-014-2, REQ-015-2, REQ-016-2, REQ-021-3, REQ-022-3, REQ-042-3)_
- **sat_sales_reason_details** — on hub_sales_reason; payload: Name, ReasonType, ModifiedDate. Sales reason description and reason category. Source table: SalesReason. _(requirements: REQ-054, REQ-055, REQ-057)_
- **sat_sales_tax_rate_details** — on hub_sales_tax_rate; payload: Name, TaxRate, ModifiedDate, rowguid. Tax rate description and amount. Source table: SalesTaxRate. _(requirements: REQ-033-2, REQ-035-2, REQ-036-2, REQ-038-2)_
- **sat_shopping_cart_item_details** — on hub_shopping_cart_item; payload: Quantity, DateCreated, ModifiedDate. Cart item quantity and creation timestamp. Source table: ShoppingCartItem. _(requirements: REQ-004-2, REQ-005-2, REQ-006-2, REQ-007-2, REQ-038-3)_
